fact: Ethio telecom's press statement, on launching its Huawei-built Tier III modular data center at Gola Sefer, Addis Ababa, gives the modular data center a power usage effectiveness of 1.4.

fact: Raxio's data sheet says the ET1 data centre in Addis Ababa takes a 33kV utility supply directly fed from the nearest substation, with 2N power redundancy and 72 hours of on-site fuel.
Raxio's data sheet states a PUE of 1.3 for the ET1 data centre, with indirect adiabatic cooling.

Raxio CTO Rob Saunders says Raxio invests in medium-voltage lines direct from the substation to its facility in each market and always uses two independently sufficient power lines, plus diesel generators.
